subtitle: Lessons Learned Through Post-Mortems
title: Learning Together
body_html:
I’ll periodically post images of my current holdings along with trade post-mortems. These updates will provide a transparent look into my trading strategy and help illustrate the thought process behind each trade.

Dynamic Nature of My Positions

Keep in mind that my positions change often. The average cost of each holding can vary over time, as I frequently:

  • Add Partials: I may increase my position size incrementally when the trade is working in my favor and showing strength.

  • Sell Partials: I often sell a portion of my holdings into strength to lock in profits and reduce risk.

  • Adjust Stop-Losses: As the trade progresses, I might move my stop-loss orders to protect gains or minimize losses.

Purpose of Trade Post-Mortems

The goal of these trade post-mortems is to provide a detailed analysis of each trade, including:

  • Entry Points: Why and when I entered the position, supported by technical and fundamental analysis.

  • Exit Points: The rationale behind selling all or part of the position, whether it was due to reaching a profit target, hitting a stop-loss, or changing market conditions.

  • Performance: An assessment of the trade's performance, including what went well and what could have been done better.

  • Lessons Learned: Key takeaways from each trade to continuously improve my strategy and decision-making process.

Visual Insights

To give you a clearer picture, I will include images of:

  • Current Holdings: Screenshots of my portfolio showing the current positions, average costs, and unrealized gains or losses.

  • Chart Analysis: Annotated charts highlighting my entry and exit points, technical indicators, and significant price movements.

Example Breakdown

Here’s what you can expect from these posts:

  1. Stock XYZ

    • Entry Point: Entered at $50 based on a breakout from a consolidation pattern with strong volume.

    • Additions: Added more at $55 as the stock showed continued strength and positive market conditions.

    • Partial Sell: Sold 30% of the position at $60 to lock in profits and reduce exposure.

    • Exit Point: Closed remaining position at $58 when the stock hit my trailing stop-loss due to market pullback.

    • Performance: Total gain of 15% on the position.

    • Lessons Learned: The importance of scaling in and out to manage risk and maximize profits.

Why This Approach?

By sharing these updates, I aim to:

  • Provide Transparency: Offer a clear view of my trading strategy and how it evolves with market conditions.

  • Foster Learning: Help other traders learn from my successes and mistakes, contributing to a collaborative trading community.

  • Stay Accountable: Keep myself accountable to my trading plan and continuously improve through self-reflection and feedback.

Conclusion

Stay tuned for regular updates on my current holdings and trade post-mortems. I hope these insights will be valuable to you, whether you're a seasoned trader or just starting out. Together, we can navigate the markets more effectively and achieve greater success.
